messages:
Nina: uploaded nsys capture from last night's matmul regression run :eyes:
Nina: short summary: cublasLt probe picked algoId=7 which needs ~24MB workspace for our 2048 seq path, we see repeated cudaMalloc/free thrash and kernel relaunches
Raj: can you paste the nsys command you ran?
Nina: `nsys profile --output matmul_probe --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --sample=none --duration=120 ./perf_test --batch 8 --seq 2048`
Nina: here's a tiny nsys summary I copied: `kernel launches +115%`, `avg kernel time +9%`, `cudaMalloc calls +300`
Morgan: looks like batching heuristic is interleaving 512 and 2048 requests — when a 2048 hits, cublasLt prober asks for big workspace, we free/alloc per-op because batch layout changes. workspace fragmentation + frequent probing = bad combo
Morgan: also KV cache warmup sometimes returns longer cached prefix for a shard which inflates sequence length estimate before batching decision
perf-bot: perf-alert: matmul_workspace_thrash detected on host g4-02 at 2051234600, correlated with increased probe_count and cudaMalloc spikes
Theo: two quick ideas: 1) memoize algo choice keyed by (op_shape_bucket, dtype, batch_size) with TTL/eviction; 2) limit probe workspace to max_workspace_threshold and fallback to safe algo if exceeded
Raj: agreed. naive memoization key example:
```
key = f"{op_type}:{m}:{n}:{k}:{dtype}:len_bucket={seq_bucket}:batch={batch_size}"
alg_cache.get_or_probe(key, probe_fn, ttl=300)
```
Raj: also add a probe-rate limiter per-worker so we don't probe on every first-seen request during a traffic surge
Nina: tried a quick patch in local env: cache hit rate went from ~12% to ~78% after a few minutes and cudaMalloc events dropped to near-zero during steady-state
Nina: pushed a draft PR with two changes: memoize by seq_bucket (powers of two), and clamp probe workspace to 8MB if batch contains mixed seq buckets. still need perf tests
Morgan: can we also change batching heuristic: avoid mixing buckets when worker_util > 60% or when KV cache suggests high prefix variance. that minimizes cross-shape allocations
Theo: for telemetry, add a metric `probe_workspace_size` and `probe_count_by_bucket`. that'll help when evaluating rollback.
Nina: thanks — i'll add metrics and run full nsys + perfetto traces on staging with the patch. scheduling capture for 2051238000 window
perf-bot: scheduled nsys capture (staging) at 2051238000 for 10m. I'll post results when done :white_check_mark:
Raj: sweet. if staging looks good we can backport to canary and measure tail latencies. consider adding a short-lived memory pool for cublasLt workspace to avoid malloc churn
Morgan: ack — i'll prototype a small slab for workspaces and wire it behind a feature flag
Nina: adding notes to PR and will @ops for canary rollout once we have traces. thanks all :clap:
